text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Vaginismus. Although you mentioned a previous suggestion of Multiple Sclerosis, your primary symptoms of involuntary pelvic floor muscle contraction preventing penetration, combined with the absence of neurological signs like sensory loss or motor weakness, strongly point to a functional disorder rather than MS.
